channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Vision Marine Technologies to sell Palm City property, consolidates operations
item.description: Vision Marine Technologies has a pending sale of its Palm City property and has consolidated tender-rigging operations at its Fort Lauderdale marina.

item.title: Martin County School District cuts 16 administrative positions to save $3.9 million
item.description: The Martin County School District plans to eliminate 16 administrative and district-level positions, including three assistant principal positions, as part of a reorganization for the upcoming school year.

item.title: Port St. Lucie pancreatic cancer patient approved for experimental treatment after 62-day wait
item.description: Russell Reed, a 64-year-old Port St. Lucie man battling pancreatic cancer, received approval to receive daraxonrasib, an experimental drug, just two days after sharing his story with WPTV.

item.title: Aldi to open first Hobe Sound grocery store Wednesday at former Winn-Dixie site
item.description: Hobe Sound is getting its first Aldi store when the new grocery store opens July 9 at 8867 SE Bridge Road, in the space where Winn-Dixie used to be.

item.title: Martin County School District to cut 16 administrative positions, save nearly $4 million
item.description: The Martin County School District plans to cut district staff as part of a reorganization for the upcoming school year, saving nearly $4 million from next year's budget.

item.title: Vero Beach homeowner says $9,000 annual insurance costs may force her to sell home
item.description: A Vero Beach homeowner says skyrocketing insurance costs may soon force her out of her home, and her story is one many Florida homeowners know all too well.

item.title: United States eliminated from World Cup after 4-1 loss to Belgium in Seattle
item.description: The United States men's soccer team saw its World Cup hopes end at home Monday night after losing 4-1 to Belgium at Lumen Field in Seattle. item.title: Serena Williams withdraws from Wimbledon doubles with sister Venus due to knee injury
item.description: Serena Williams withdrew from her doubles match with sister Venus at Wimbledon on Saturday due to a right knee injury sustained during her singles return earlier in the week.

item.title: President Trump called FIFA president before World Cup suspension of Folarin Balogun was lifted
item.description: President Donald Trump intervened on behalf of American star forward Folarin Balogun, whose red card suspension was lifted before Monday's World Cup match against Belgium.

item.title: Florida median-income households now need 17 months longer to save for home down payment
item.description: A new study shows that saving for a down payment on a home takes significantly longer for Florida households than it did a decade ago.

item.description: Taylor Morrison has started construction on a Wilczynski-designed golf course at its new Esplanade at Solaeris residential community in Port St. Lucie.
